articles.title: Suspected drones seen over French military intelligence base, armed forces say
articles.summary: Suspected drones were observed flying over a French military intelligence base near Paris on three separate nights last month, prompting a security alert. The French Air and Space Force confirmed the incidents, which are part of a series of unauthorized drone flights over sensitive French sites. These events raise concerns about national security and potential reconnaissance activities, highlighting the evolving challenges in airspace protection.

articles.title: HII Deepens Partnership with Babcock International Group in Support of Virginia-Class Submarine Construction
articles.summary: HII (Huntington Ingalls Industries) and Babcock International Group have expanded their strategic partnership through a new contract. This collaboration between the major U.S. and UK defence companies likely aims to strengthen naval capabilities, possibly involving submarine technology and maintenance. articles.title: Eyeing IAF's transport aircraft deal, Lockheed Martin plans to set up co-production facility for C-130J planes in India
articles.summary: US aerospace major Lockheed Martin plans to establish a co-production facility in India for its C-130J Super Hercules heavy-lift military transport aircraft. This strategic initiative supports India's 'Make in India' drive, enhancing indigenous defence manufacturing, technology transfer, and job creation. For SSB aspirants, this highlights strengthening India's defence industrial base, critical aerospace capabilities, and deepening strategic partnerships with the US.

articles.title: South Korea scrambles jets after Russian, Chinese planes approach
articles.summary: South Korea scrambled fighter jets after seven Russian and two Chinese military aircraft entered its Air Defence Identification Zone (ADIZ) on Tuesday. This incident, involving multiple powers in a sensitive region, prompted Seoul's immediate response to an undeclared entry. Such joint flyovers by Russia and China often raise concerns about regional security dynamics and military posturing, highlighting the importance of air defence readiness.

articles.title: Goa nightclub fire: Luthra brothers in Thailand, police focus on tracking third owner, raid Gurgaon residence
articles.summary: Police investigating the Goa nightclub fire, which tragically killed 25 people, have confirmed a third owner involved, in addition to brothers Saurabh and Gaurav Luthra, who fled to Thailand. This development intensifies the probe into accountability and potential negligence behind the incident. The investigation aims to uncover all responsible parties and address safety lapses in commercial establishments, underscoring the importance of strict regulatory compliance.
